reason: H0 replaces the rollout module's ungated start/retry with one current batch/immutable acceptance/freshness check. Seven internal server exports: two strict v4 metadata types, three pure codec/digest/freshness functions qualified by Python golden vectors, and two transaction wrappers for the existing migration-token-only verifier/header routes.
